import os, ctypes, torch, subprocess
D='/tmp/e5'
print('present', os.path.exists(f'{D}/hand.so'))
print(subprocess.run(f'cuobjdump --dump-resource-usage {D}/hand.so 2>&1 | grep -E "Function|REG" | head -12',shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
vp=ctypes.c_void_p; ci=ctypes.c_int
H=ctypes.CDLL(f'{D}/hand.so'); H.adamod_tc_pairnb.argtypes=[vp,vp,vp,vp,ci,ci,vp]
dev='cuda'; res={}
for draw in range(3):
    torch.manual_seed(100+draw)
    W=torch.randn(18432,3072,device=dev)/3072**0.5; bias=torch.randn(18432,device=dev); Wd=W.double()
    for B,nb in [(373,1),(384,1),(449,1),(512,1),(773,2),(853,2)]:
        emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device=dev); outs=[torch.zeros(B,3072,device=dev) for _ in range(6)]
        arr=(vp*6)(*[t.data_ptr() for t in outs])
        r=H.adamod_tc_pairnb(emb.data_ptr(),W.data_ptr(),bias.data_ptr(),ctypes.cast(arr,vp),B,nb,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        d=(torch.cat(outs,1).double()-(emb.double()@Wd.T+bias.double())).abs()
        res.setdefault(B,[]).append(round(d.max().item()*1e3,2))
print({k:v for k,v in res.items()})
